Policies and Initiatives.title: BoldCap-backed Pramaana Labs raises $27 Mn led by Khosla Ventures
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Pramaana Labs, an AI verification and accountability platform, has raised $27 million in a seed funding round led by Khosla Ventures. The round also saw participation from notable investors such as Accel, Boldcap, and Premji Invest. The funds will be used to train models, hire AI researchers, and expand its network of domain experts across regulated industries.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Dharmendra Pradhan opens IIT Madras tech summit in Delhi
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan inaugurated the IIT Madras Technology Summit 2026 in Delhi. The summit focuses on deep-tech and industry collaboration, bringing together key stakeholders in the field. The event aims to foster innovation and partnerships between academia and industry.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Vikra Ocean Tech raises $1 Mn from Finvolve and India Accelerator
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Vikra Ocean Tech, a deeptech startup, has raised $1 million in a seed funding round co-led by Finvolve and India Accelerator. The funds will be used to scale product manufacturing, strengthen sales, and establish recurring revenue streams. The startup, co-founded in 2019, develops an indigenous ocean robotics ecosystem for various applications.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Why Tamil Nadu Isn’t Waiting for Students to Visit Tech Conferences
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Tamil Nadu's IT minister Palanivel Thiaga Rajan thinks software development is no longer a default career choice. The state is taking proactive steps to engage with students, rather than waiting for them to attend tech conferences. This approach aims to promote awareness and interest in the field among students.

Policies and Initiatives.title: SanchiConnect Partners With Tamil Nadu & iTNT to Support Deep Tech Startups in Tier-2, 3 Cities
Policies and Initiatives.summary: SanchiConnect has partnered with Tamil Nadu and iTNT to support deep tech startups in Tier-2 and 3 cities. The initiative aims to build a sustainable ecosystem for innovation across key sectors, including climate technology and health tech. This partnership seeks to foster growth and development in these areas.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Sarvam AI signs MoU with TN Govt to set up  sovereign AI park with ₹10,000 cr investment
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Sarvam AI has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tamil Nadu government to establish a sovereign AI park. The project is expected to attract an investment of ₹10,000 crore. This initiative aims to promote the development of artificial intelligence in the region.

Events.title: Why The AI Foundry by Tredence in Chennai is a Working Room for Builders, Not Another Conference
Events.summary: The AI Foundry by Tredence in Chennai is a closed-door workshop where senior practitioners design and prototype production-ready AI systems. This working room is geared towards builders, differing from traditional conferences. Participants will collaborate to create functional AI systems in a hands-on environment.

Major AI Developments.title: India Must  Enact AI Regulation Act to Ensure Fairness and Accountability
Major AI Developments.summary: India is being urged to enact an AI Regulation Act to ensure fairness and accountability in the use of artificial intelligence. This move is seen as necessary to address concerns around AI's potential impact on society. The proposed act aims to establish guidelines and standards for the development and deployment of AI systems in India.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras Pravartak aims to train 10 lakh students in AI in the next three years
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Madras Pravartak has set a goal to train 10 lakh students in artificial intelligence (AI) over the next three years. This initiative aims to enhance AI skills among a large number of students in a short span of time. The program is part of IIT Madras' efforts to promote AI education and development.

Major AI Developments.title: Huge potential to use AI effectively in public healthcare; need to create digital database of patients: Soumya Swaminathan
Major AI Developments.summary: Soumya Swaminathan highlights the huge potential of using AI in public healthcare. To effectively utilize AI, she emphasizes the need to create a digital database of patients. This initiative aims to improve public healthcare services by leveraging AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: Madras Sappers Museum opens to the public in Bengaluru
Major AI Developments.summary: The Madras Sappers Museum in Bengaluru, established in 1979, has opened to the public, showcasing the history of the Madras Engineer Group. The museum features AI-restored archives, rare military artefacts, and stories from World War II and beyond. It provides a unique glimpse into the group's history through its extensive collection of military memorabilia and restored archives.

Major AI Developments.title: TOI correction: Viral bus ticket story fake, AI-generated image sparked misinformation
Major AI Developments.summary: A viral story about a bus ticket has been debunked as fake, sparked by an AI-generated image that spread misinformation. The image was mistakenly believed to be real, leading to the spread of false information. The correction confirms that the story and image were entirely fabricated.

Major AI Developments.title: As robotics boom, startups race to capture real-world AI training data
Major AI Developments.summary: Startups are racing to capture real-world AI training data as the robotics industry experiences a boom. This data is crucial for training AI models to perform tasks in real-world environments. The demand for high-quality training data has sparked competition among startups to collect and provide this data to companies developing robotics and AI technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Netrasemi eyes commercial production of its AI chips by 2027
Major AI Developments.summary: Netrasemi aims to start commercial production of its AI chips by 2027. The company is working towards achieving this milestone, marking a significant step in the development of its artificial intelligence technology. Commercial production is expected to begin within the next few years, with 2027 set as the target date.

Major AI Developments.title: Chartered accountants should see AI, machine learning and other tech developments as an opportunity: G Ramaswamy
Major AI Developments.summary: Technological advancements like AI and blockchain are transforming the chartered accountant profession, pushing CAs towards higher-value advisory roles. Data literacy is becoming increasingly important, alongside technical accounting knowledge. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is expanding its reach, with growing demand for the CA course and placement opportunities.

Major AI Developments.title: TN Deploys AIoT-based Automated Water Level Recorder Systems At 44 Dams, Reservoirs And Regulator Sites
Major AI Developments.summary: Tamil Nadu has deployed AIoT-based automated water level recorder systems at 44 dams, reservoirs, and regulator sites. The systems aim to provide real-time monitoring and data collection, enhancing water management and flood control efforts. This initiative marks a significant step in leveraging technology to improve water resource management in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: Enquiries on AI and Data Science courses remain top in Coimbatore colleges
Major AI Developments.summary: Enquiries for AI and Data Science courses are the most popular in Coimbatore colleges. These courses have garnered significant interest among students, indicating a growing demand for education in these fields. Coimbatore colleges are witnessing a high volume of enquiries for these courses, reflecting the increasing appeal of AI and Data Science programs.

Major AI Developments.title: TTV calls TVK’s video AI; party claims support voluntary
Major AI Developments.summary: TTV has called TVK's video AI, with the party claiming that the support is voluntary. The move is reportedly a significant development, although details are scarce. Further information on the implications of this call is not provided in the available content.

Major AI Developments.title: TTV Dhinakaran accuses TVK chief Vijay of indulging in forgery to become Tamil Nadu CM
Major AI Developments.summary: AMMK leader TTV Dhinakaran has accused TVK chief Vijay of forgery in an attempt to become the Tamil Nadu CM. Dhinakaran claims a video showing his party's winning candidate supporting TVK is AI-generated. He has demanded an inquiry into the allegedly forged letter submitted to the Governor.

Major AI Developments.title: M&M eyes Rs 4,100cr auto revenue boost from AI in FY27
Major AI Developments.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M) aims to increase its auto revenue by Rs 4,100cr in FY27, driven by the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. The company expects AI to play a significant role in boosting its revenue in the upcoming fiscal year. M&M's AI-driven initiatives are anticipated to contribute substantially to its growth plans.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras’s first tech summit held in New Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Madras held its first tech summit in New Delhi, marking a significant event for the institution. The summit aimed to bring together experts and showcase technological advancements, although specific details of the event are not provided. IIT Madras's decision to host the summit in New Delhi highlights its efforts to expand its reach and collaborate with other stakeholders in the tech industry.

Major AI Developments.title: ML questions Bengal, Tamil Nadu poll results
Major AI Developments.summary: The CPI(ML) has expressed dissatisfaction with the recent election results in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu, citing significant voter roll purges as a factor in their losses. The party claims that millions of voters were unjustly removed, which contributed to the BJP's success in Bengal and other electoral outcomes. The CPI(ML) is questioning the legitimacy of the results due to these alleged purges.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s challenge lies in developing AI-insulated jobs, says chief economic adviser V Anantha Nageswaran at Chennai event
Major AI Developments.summary: India's chief economic adviser, V Anantha Nageswaran, stated that the country's challenge lies in developing jobs that are insulated from the impact of artificial intelligence. He made this statement at an event in Chennai, highlighting the need for AI-resistant employment opportunities. Nageswaran's comment emphasizes the importance of creating jobs that cannot be easily automated by AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Hosp uses AI to cut radiation in lung cancer screening
Major AI Developments.summary: A hospital is utilizing AI technology to reduce radiation exposure in lung cancer screenings. This innovative approach aims to minimize the risks associated with traditional screening methods. The AI-powered system helps optimize radiation doses while maintaining image quality for accurate diagnoses.

Major AI Developments.title: Summer camps turn high-tech this year as robotics, AI keep students engaged
Major AI Developments.summary: Summer camps are incorporating high-tech activities such as robotics and AI to keep students engaged. These tech-infused camps aim to provide an interactive and immersive learning experience for students during their summer break. By integrating robotics and AI, camps are making learning a fun and engaging experience for students.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras Swayam Plus launches three AI courses
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Madras Swayam Plus has launched three new courses focused on Artificial Intelligence. The launch is part of the institution's efforts to provide accessible education in emerging technologies like AI. These courses aim to equip students with knowledge and skills in AI, but specific details about the courses are not provided.

Major AI Developments.title: AI hologram campaigns take TN polls by storm as Vijay’s virtual avatar draws crowds
Major AI Developments.summary: AI-powered holograms of Vijay are being used in election campaigns in Tamil Nadu, allowing for virtual outreach and immersive voter engagement. This technology is being adopted by political parties to enhance their visibility and appeal ahead of the Assembly elections. The use of holograms is transforming the election campaign landscape in the state, drawing large crowds and increasing voter interaction.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘AI adoption likely to spur consolidation in data analytics space’
Major AI Developments.summary: The adoption of artificial intelligence is expected to drive consolidation in the data analytics space. As AI becomes more prevalent, companies may look to acquire or merge with other firms to enhance their data analytics capabilities. This consolidation is likely to reshape the data analytics industry in the near future.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras director advocates Sanskrit’s role in advancing AI technology
Major AI Developments.summary: The director of IIT Madras has spoken out about the potential benefits of Sanskrit in advancing AI technology. According to the director, Sanskrit can play a significant role in the development of artificial intelligence. The ancient language's unique grammatical structure is seen as a potential asset in improving AI systems.

Major AI Developments.title: Chennai college asks students to declare AI use in assignments
Major AI Developments.summary: A college in Chennai has introduced a new policy requiring students to declare if they have used artificial intelligence in their assignments. This move aims to promote academic integrity and prevent plagiarism. Students will now have to disclose AI usage to ensure transparency in their work.

Major AI Developments.title: With $10mn raise, Gnani aims to scale voice AI models, tap global markets
Major AI Developments.summary: Gnani has raised $10 million to scale its voice AI models and expand into global markets. The funding will enable the company to enhance its AI capabilities and tap into new international markets. This investment is expected to drive Gnani's growth and increase its global presence.

Major AI Developments.title: Tamil Nadu elections: CM MK Stalin counters EPS’s fridge promise with Rs 8k for non-tax paying women
Major AI Developments.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin has unveiled the DMK's new manifesto, promising significant welfare boosts, including doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000. Non-tax paying women will also receive Rs 8,000 household coupons, while farmers will get free motor pumpsets. The party aims to drive FDI growth, job creation, and AI development, along with supporting fishermen.

Major AI Developments.title: Pavestone leads $3 Mn seed round in lending solutions platform Uncia
Major AI Developments.summary: Uncia, a lending solutions platform, has raised $3 million in a seed funding round led by Pavestone, a Hyderabad-based venture capital firm. The funds will be used to accelerate growth in India and support the company's expansion into the Middle East, North Africa, and North America. Uncia is an AI-native lending technology firm that provides digital infrastructure for banks and non-banking financial companies (NBFCs).

Major AI Developments.title: Rocketlane raises $60 Mn in Series C led by Insight Partners
Major AI Developments.summary: Rocketlane, a Chennai-based professional services automation platform, has raised $60 million in its Series C round led by Insight Partners. This investment brings the company's total funding to $105 million. The company had previously raised $24 million in its Series B round and $18 million in its Series A round from investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners India, and Nexus Venture Partners.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras Expands Free Digital Education Initiative Vidya Shakti to Reach More Rural Students
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Madras is expanding its Vidya Shakti program, a free digital education initiative that provides online classes in math, science, and English to rural students. The program aims to reach 10,000 more students next year, utilizing virtual reality and AI tools to enhance learning outcomes. This expansion seeks to improve education across India, particularly in rural areas.

Major AI Developments.title: Future transit systems, AI yoga among IIT students’ innovations
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT students have developed innovative projects, including future transit systems and AI-powered yoga. These innovations showcase the students' creativity and ability to apply technology to real-world problems. The projects demonstrate the potential for AI and other technologies to improve various aspects of life, from transportation to wellness.

Major AI Developments.title: Count on AI to make legalese easy as A, B, C
Major AI Developments.summary: AI is being utilized to simplify complex legal language, making it more accessible and understandable. This technology aims to break down legalese into easier-to-comprehend terms, similar to basic alphabet letters. The goal is to make legal concepts more straightforward for everyone to grasp.

Major AI Developments.title: Chennai UPHCs to use AI in X-ray screening to detect TB cases early
Major AI Developments.summary: Chennai's Urban Primary Health Centres (UPHCs) will utilize artificial intelligence (AI) in X-ray screening to detect tuberculosis (TB) cases at an early stage. This initiative aims to improve diagnosis and treatment of TB patients. The AI-powered X-ray screening is expected to enhance the efficiency of TB detection in the city.

Major AI Developments.title: SRMIST introduces AI agent for faculty hiring
Major AI Developments.summary: SRMIST has introduced an AI agent to streamline its faculty hiring process. The AI agent is designed to simplify the recruitment of faculty members, although specific details of its functionality are not provided. This move marks a significant step towards leveraging technology in academic hiring processes.

Major AI Developments.title: embedUR systems expects edge AI platform to drive growth
Major AI Developments.summary: EmbedUR Systems anticipates significant growth driven by its edge AI platform. The company expects this platform to be a key factor in its expansion. Edge AI technology enables faster and more efficient processing of data at the source, reducing reliance on cloud computing.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-M research foundation to set up AI innovation centre in Dubai
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT-M research foundation is establishing an AI innovation centre in Dubai to promote artificial intelligence advancements. The centre aims to foster collaboration and innovation in the field of AI, although specific details about the project are not provided. The initiative is expected to contribute to the growth of AI technology in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Intellect Design Arena targets mid-sized firms for AI platform
Major AI Developments.summary: Intellect Design Arena is targeting mid-sized firms to adopt its AI platform, aiming to expand its customer base. The company's AI platform is designed to help businesses improve their operations and decision-making capabilities. Intellect Design Arena's move is expected to increase the adoption of AI technology among mid-sized firms.

Major AI Developments.title: AI demand presents a golden opportunity for India to crack the $400 bn chip equipment supply chain
Major AI Developments.summary: India has a chance to break into the $400 billion chip equipment supply chain due to increasing demand for AI. The growing need for AI technology presents an opportunity for India to establish itself in the global semiconductor industry. This could potentially boost India's economy and technological advancements.

Major AI Developments.title: Zoho Launches AI-native ERP Platform From Rural Tamil Nadu
Major AI Developments.summary: Zoho has launched a low-code, AI-native ERP platform for end-to-end financial and operational management. The platform, called Zoho ERP, offers a comprehensive solution for businesses. It was launched from Zoho's rural Tamil Nadu location.

Major AI Developments.title: Tredence Introduces Agentic Commerce Accelerators for Retailers
Major AI Developments.summary: Tredence has introduced Agentic Commerce Accelerators, a framework that utilizes agents to interpret shopper intent. The framework orchestrates personalized interactions for retailers, enhancing their customer experience. This technology aims to provide tailored interactions for shoppers, potentially boosting retail sales and customer satisfaction.

AI Start-Up News.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 23 - Mar 28]
AI Start-Up News.summary: 30 Indian startups raised around $286.52 million in funding this week, with 7 growth-stage, 17 early-stage, and 6 undisclosed deals. This amount is nearly equal to the $286.54 million secured by 26 startups in the previous week. The funding landscape remains steady, with a consistent flow of investments in Indian startups.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rocketlane raises $60 mn, eyes expansion from AI adoption
AI Start-Up News.summary: Rocketlane has raised $60 million in funding, with plans to expand its operations. The company aims to leverage artificial intelligence adoption to drive its growth and expansion. This investment is expected to fuel Rocketlane's further development and market reach.

AI Start-Up News.title: How Attox Research Lab is helping doctors fight the growing threat of superbugs
AI Start-Up News.summary: Attox Research Lab, a Chennai-based healthtech startup, has developed a device for rapid antibiotic sensitivity analysis. The device uses AI to determine the effective antibiotic for a specific bacteria in just two hours. This significantly reduces the time compared to traditional methods, which take 24-78 hours.

AI Start-Up News.title: Prashant Pitti’s Optimo Capital raises Rs 100 Cr from PNB
AI Start-Up News.summary: Optimo Capital, a tech-led NBFC, has raised Rs 100 crore in debt funding from Punjab National Bank and partnered with Godrej Finance to co-lend Rs 200 crore over 12 months. This development comes six months after the company secured Rs 150 crore in equity funding led by Blume Ventures and Omnivore. Optimo Capital focuses on MSME lending, offering digital secured loan-against-property products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit.

AI Start-Up News.title: KaarTech raises $11M in Series B round led by Playbook Partners
AI Start-Up News.summary: KaarTech, a Chennai-based technology services company, has raised $11 million in a Series B funding round led by Playbook Partners. The company plans to utilize the capital for strategic acquisitions and expanding its market reach. The funding will support the growth of its AI platforms.

AI Start-Up News.title: The ePlane Company plans $40–50 Mn funding in Series C round: Report
AI Start-Up News.summary: The ePlane Company, an electric aircraft company, is planning to raise $40-50 million in a Series C funding round. Speciale Invest will co-lead the round, which will be a mix of equity and convertible instruments. The Chennai-based company has previously raised $20 million from Speciale Invest and others.
